grid.row_count_note: design-guide 6.2 grid = 39 rows (7 geometry x 4 combos + 8 dual-stream 1080p fps + 3 extra clock tiers). The 4 single-core/single-stream 1080p fps rows are added because design-guide 6.3 rule 4 requires the best single-core 1080p 25%-margin fps; they are a documented superset, not a replacement.

verdict_rules.condition: marginal_eram_total > 300 (resource cannot fit even in the expected column) OR routed ERAM > 300
verdict_rules.note: conservative >300 alone is NOT infeasible (marginal <=300 -> conditional)

verdict_rules.condition: per_stream full-chain margin at the row fps < 0
verdict_rules.note: core-only or aggregate margins may not be substituted; chain is the system basis

verdict_rules.condition: cores == 2 and dual-core Routed timing is unproven
verdict_rules.note: dual-core can never be feasible in this run; timing unproven caps at conditional

verdict_rules.condition: per_stream full-chain margin >= 25% AND conservative ERAM <= 270/300 AND timing proven
verdict_rules.note: only single-core rows can currently satisfy this; single-core routed timing proven at <=187.5 MHz

verdict_rules.condition: otherwise (0 <= per_stream full-chain margin < 25%, or conservative 271-300 with marginal <=300, or timing unproven)
verdict_rules.note: below the 25% design gate is not a PASS

verdict_rules.condition: no row in the whole grid has 30 fps per-stream margin >= 0%
verdict_rules.note: system-level only; current grid does contain such rows, so not_viable must not be emitted

gate_status_rule.fails_30: per_stream full-chain margin < 0% at the row fps (literal 30 only when fps=30)

per_stream_capacity.2core_2streams: C (one frozen core per stream; NOT 2C)

capacity_rules.chain_primary: 1920x1080 uses the measured full_grad anchor cycles=6421414; other geometry uses cycles_core(W,H)+426385 (assumed), with 0 and 1,000,000 as sensitivity tiers
capacity_rules.core_basis: comp fixed vector (slowest measured core content)
capacity_rules.clock_scaling: cycles per frame are clock-independent; capacity scales linearly with clock

packing_rules.raw_bytes: W*H*5/4; W must be a multiple of 4; H does not have to be a multiple of 4 (1440x810 is valid: 1800 B row stride, 291600 groups, no padding)

negative_controls.name: synthesized resource/timing mixed into routed fit

overhead_sensitivity.anchor_note: 1080p always uses the measured 6,421,414-cycle anchor; the overhead tier does not apply there (applies=false, identical values in all tiers)
overhead_sensitivity.output: out/overhead-sensitivity.csv (43 scenarios x 3 tiers = 129 rows, verdict re-derived per tier)
overhead_sensitivity.rule: a recommendation is 'robust across tiers' only if its per-stream chain margin is >=25% in ALL three tiers; otherwise the tier dependence must be stated in the report

recommendation_rules.primary: largest per-stream pixel count among 30 fps rows with full-chain margin >= 25% at the primary overhead tier (426385); tie-break prefer cores=1, then streams=1
recommendation_rules.primary_tier_caveat: if the same row falls below 25% at the conservative tier (1000000), the report must present it as feasible-at-primary-tier / conditional-at-conservative-tier, never as unconditional feasible
recommendation_rules.alternate_robust_resolution: largest-pixel 30 fps single-core/single-stream row meeting 25% in ALL three overhead tiers (0 / 426385 / 1000000)
recommendation_rules.alternate_fps: highest 1080p fps among single-core/single-stream rows with margin >= 25% (anchor is tier-invariant)
recommendation_rules.required_clock: each recommendation must state required_clock_chain_25_mhz and required_clock_core_25_mhz = cycles_per_frame * fps * 1.25
forbidden: dual-core as an unconditional primary recommendation
claiming unconditional feasible when the conservative overhead tier is below 25%

frontier_rules.margin_source: margin_pct must be the same-source margin as capacity_basis: core_only_comp -> margin_core_pct; full_chain_* -> margin_chain_pct
frontier_rules.gate_source: gate_25 must be derived from margin_pct with the frozen 25% gate
frontier_rules.worst_tier: worst_tier_margin_pct = min over the three overhead tiers (anchor-fixed for 1080p)
